risk_summary.quantity_basis: gross held positions; pending orders not netted

positions.thesis: Corteva is a seed-pricing, crop-protection productivity, and separation position. Seed technology and cost discipline must preserve margin growth while the September investor days and October Vylor spin create two investable companies without operational disruption or stranded costs.
A development-stage bet on Project Matador becoming a scarce, gigawatt-scale powered AI campus. Commercial agreements and funded delivery—not headline capacity—must validate it.

AAON is a data-center cooling and custom HVAC capacity-ramp position. Record BASX demand and a $2.0 billion backlog must convert into revenue, improving gross margin, and cash generation faster than Memphis overhead, outsourcing, and working-capital needs consume the upside.

Legacy Robinhood protein holding. The GLP-1 muscle-preservation theme does not currently provide a clean BRBR-specific public-equity expression; retain it transparently while brand-level volume, pricing, and margin evidence either creates a direct thesis or invalidates it.

RoboStrategy is a closed-end private-robotics access position. Monthly NAV growth and portfolio-company financing or liquidity events must outrun the stock's premium to stale Level 3 marks, a 3.98% estimated expense load, dilution, and weak price discovery.

Figure is a capital-light consumer-credit marketplace position. Loan volume, Figure Connect adoption, and partner growth must translate into durable adjusted revenue and earnings without credit deterioration, warehouse-funding stress, or mark-to-market noise masking economics.

Hims & Hers is a subscription-health platform and international expansion position. Subscriber growth and personalized care must sustain domestic reacceleration and profitable scale while regulatory, pharmacy, acquisition-integration, and product-mix risks remain controlled.

Nike is a brand-and-distribution turnaround position. Wholesale growth and performance-product traction must become durable revenue and margin recovery while NIKE Direct, Greater China, inventory units, and tariff exposure stop consuming the upside.

Oscar Health is an ACA individual-market scale position. Membership growth and technology-led operating leverage must preserve medical-cost discipline as enhanced subsidies expire and 2027 integrity rules test enrollment quality, pricing, and retention.

Toast is a restaurant operating-system and payments position. Location and GPV growth, enterprise adoption, AI products, and margin expansion must compound without weaker restaurant demand, payments compression, credit losses, or hardware and support costs eroding the economics.

CoreWeave is a leveraged AI-infrastructure demand position. A $104 billion backlog and more than $25 billion of early-Q3 commitments must convert into delivered capacity, revenue, and operating leverage faster than debt, interest, capex, and customer concentration consume the upside.

Live Nation is a live-events demand and venue-capacity position. Record ticket sales and deferred revenue must convert into double-digit adjusted operating income and cash flow while legal remedies, capital intensity, weather, and artist or fan affordability do not impair the flywheel.

DoorDash is a local-commerce network position. Order and GOV growth, DashPass engagement, Deliveroo integration, and grocery/retail unit economics must compound faster than insurance, regulation, autonomy investment, and international complexity consume the margin upside.
